issuer: Access Canberra, for the ACT road transport authority
note: Read 2026-10-30 on the ACT Legislation Register. The Road Transport (Driver Licensing) Regulation 2000 (republication R83, effective 13 June 2026): a provisional car licence from 17 (s 22) and a full car licence once a provisional licence has been held at least 3 years (s 35), so a full licence is kept from 20; a full licence is issued for a period the authority decides, not longer than 11 years (s 37). The Road Transport (General) (Driver Licence and Related Fees) Determination 2026 (No 1), DI2026-44, item 5: a full licence valid for 5 years, $270.70 from 1 July 2026 (a 10-year one $503.80); the 5-year licence is held. Access Canberra's own pages refused the request behind a Cloudflare check. The ACT's proof of identity card isn't held (its fee instrument wasn't read).

sources.said: (a) the person is at least 17 years old; and ... The eligibility requirement for a full car licence is that the person has held a provisional licence (other than a provisional motorcycle licence) for at least 3 years. ... A full licence must be issued to a person for the period (not longer than 11 years) decided by the road transport authority.
